# Elementor

> Elementor is an all-in-one WordPress website builder platform combining drag-and-drop design, AI-powered tools, hosting, and business solutions for creators, agencies, and enterprises.

Elementor provides a comprehensive ecosystem for building and managing WordPress websites, from visual page editing and AI content generation to managed hosting, domain registration, and multi-site management. The platform serves individual creators, agencies, and enterprises with scalability and collaboration features.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- Drag-and-drop editor

- Elementor One

## Core Products & Platform

- [Website builder: Create a Website Now | Elementor](https://elementor.com): Elementor homepage: free website builder with AI Site Planner and drag-and-drop editor
- [Editor: Website Builder for WordPress: 21M+ sites | Elementor](https://elementor.com/products/website-builder): Elementor Editor WordPress plugin: drag-and-drop builder with design tools and optimization
- [One | Elementor](https://elementor.com/one): Elementor One subscription plan with all-in-one platform, AI integration, and credits system
- [AI website builder for WordPress | Elementor](https://elementor.com/products/ai): Elementor AI: AI-powered WordPress website builder with AI Copilot and content generation
- [AI Site Planner: generate sitemaps & wireframes in minutes](https://elementor.com/ai-site-planner): AI Site Planner: AI-generated sitemaps, wireframes, and briefs for web design workflow

## Specialized Builders & Commerce

- [Builder for WooCommerce: Design a store that sells](https://elementor.com/ecommerce-builder): Elementor WooCommerce builder: visual store design with product pages and checkout customization
- [The best themes for WordPress websites | Elementor](https://elementor.com/themes): Elementor WordPress themes including Hello and Hello Biz lightweight theme options
- [Angie: AI for WordPress creation & management | Elementor](https://elementor.com/products/angie-ai-for-wordpress): Angie: free AI tool for WordPress with custom widgets and natural language automation

## Performance & Optimization

- [Speed Performance | Elementor](https://elementor.com/speed-performance): Elementor speed performance: Core Web Vitals optimization with caching and lazy loading
- [Image Optimizer: PNG, JPG & GIFs, convert to WebP & AVIF](https://elementor.com/products/image-optimizer): Image Optimizer: compress and convert images to WebP/AVIF for WordPress site speed
- [Ally: Web accessibility plugin for WordPress | Elementor](https://elementor.com/products/ally-web-accessibility): Ally: AI-powered WordPress accessibility plugin for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance

## Hosting & Domain Management

- [Hosting for WordPress: ultra fast, cloud, managed & secure](https://elementor.com/hosting): Elementor hosting: managed WordPress hosting powered by Google Cloud and Cloudflare CDN
- [Buy a Domain Name | Register domain names with Elementor](https://elementor.com/domains): Domain registration and management with Elementor hosting integration
- [Connect your domain to a website | Elementor](https://elementor.com/help/connect-your-domain-to-a-website): Guide: connect domain to Elementor website with DNS configuration and setup
